description: Mahawa Pradeshiya Sabha - Declared to be considered as Roads and Lanes owned by the Maho Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters - the declaration of roads and lanes as owned by the Maho Pradeshiya Sabha. It contains detailed schedules of specific roads with coordinates, lengths, and widths, making it primarily about land ownership and property rights rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories. The content focuses on the transfer and affirmation of ownership of physical infrastructure (roads and lanes) to the local government authority.
